_help: days    : '3-6' range | '1,3,5' list | '2-8/2' every other | '4' one day
times   : M=Morning A=Afternoon E=Evening N=Night. Combine: 'M,A' or 'M,A,E,N'
move    : bare pattern name, or {pattern, speed, distance, axis, radius}
requires: 'beaten: NAME' | 'met: NAME' | 'flag: NAME', any prefixed with 'not '.
Compound gates use the longhand object form.
when    : optional rule list, evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM, FIRST MATCH WINS.
A rule states when the character is present plus ONLY what differs.
Anything a rule omits falls back to the character's own value above.
loop    : set false for story characters who must never repeat when the
calendar loops -- they are matched against the real day instead.

says.meet: Out in the forest too hey? I'm glad they managed to reopen it today, the storm we had last week was really bad.
says.repeat: If I was younger I'd do a daily run in here. It's always cool with the shade of the trees and there's a lot of water with all the ponds.

says.meet: Hello there, out in the forest too hey? I'm glad they managed to reopen it today, the storm we had last week was really bad and I was worried half of the forest would be flooded or gone!
says.repeat: If I was younger I'd do my daily run in here. It's always cool with the shade of the trees so it's never as hot as out in the harbour.

says.meet: I'm glad we can finally get our hands on these packs. You look like you haven't opened many of these so have one on me. Spread the word you can buy them here.
says.repeat: Hope you pulled something good from that.

says.meet: Me and my husband used to go everywhere, all over the world, but we've slowed down since moving here. It's peaceful here and it makes you appreciate the smaller things
says.repeat: The world is large and there's a lot in it, but even this forest itself is a world of it's own, full of life entirely self contained that will never leave it's boundaries.

says.meet: I always come here to throw a coin in the well and make a wish but they never come true. Maybe if I give this to you instead it'll work better.

says.first_win: I was far too safe.

says.rematch_win: I wonder if the circus will take me back....

says.meet: I'm a pretty good Doctor but the work is stressful so I like to take a walk in the forest to clear my head in the evening.
says.repeat: I'm still enjoying the fresh air after my long shift.
says.first_win: Medical school is long and hard, I didn't have a lot of time to practice cards.
says.rematch_win: I'm always too tired!
says.loss: I can treat you for any bad ailment other than a loss!

says.meet: Hah! I'm Blaine! I was the Leader of Cinnabar Gym before it burned down in the volcanic eruption. I retired but I'm here to help run this challenge. You won't be able to use certain trainers in your deck if you're taking part.
says.repeat: I'll never give up until I win.
says.first_win: Awesome. I've burned out...
says.rematch_win: I have burned down to nothing! Not even ashes remain!
says.loss: My fiery Pokémon will incinerate all challengers!

says.meet: I'm Brock, the Ex Gym Leader of Pewter City and expert on Rock-type Pokemon. I'm practicing hard before the challenge begins. Did you know about the ruleset? Some trainer cards are banned for the challenge so you can't use them in your deck. Show me your best.
says.repeat: I really enjoyed our last match. Want to give it another shot?
says.first_win: You overcame my rock hard defence!
says.rematch_win: Looks like you're the stronger one.
says.loss: The best offense is a good defense! That's my way of doing things!

says.meet: Hello, such pleasant weather here, I'm afraid I may doze off... My name is Erika. I was the leader of Celadon Gym. If you want a match with me you'll need to make sure you don't use any banned trainer cards.
says.repeat: Plants are such delicate things. The amount of water, the condition of the soil, the temperature differences, the changing weather can have such a huge effect. Sorry.. you want another match?
says.first_win: That was a delightful match. I felt inspired
says.rematch_win: Losing leaves a bitter aftertaste... But knowing that there are strong players spurs me to do better...
says.loss: Oh... Is that all?

says.meet: I shall spare you a moment of my time. I am the ex Gym Leader Giovanni. I believe Team Rocket has arrived but I know nothing of their plans. I am merely here for the Gym Hero Challenge.
says.repeat: Two things are inevitable: my success and your failure.
says.first_win: What? Me, lose?!
says.rematch_win: I hope we meet again...
says.loss: Mark my words. Not being able to measure your own strength shows that you are still but a child.

says.meet: Fwahaha! I am Koga. I was part of the Elite Four but most importantly an Ex Gym Leader. My style will confound and destroy you! Confusion, sleep, poison... Prepare to be the victim of my sinister technique!
says.repeat: I, too, must pursue further discipline.
says.first_win: Humph! You have proven your worth!
says.rematch_win: I subjected you to everything I could muster. But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills
says.loss: Have you learned to fear the techniques of the ninja?

says.meet: Hey Kid, you're in for a shock if you think you can beat me at the Gym Challenge. You'll need to hold your nerve against me. I'm using the Gym Challenge rules, so don't think about using any banned trainer cards.
says.repeat: Still slugging and chugging away?
says.first_win: Even my electric tricks lost. You're good at this.
says.rematch_win: When it comes to Electric type Pokemon, I'm number one. Card games? Clearly not so much hahaha.
says.loss: Ha, you shorted out?

says.meet: This bridge really reminds me of home. I'm Misty, the Ex Gym Leader of Cerulean. I'm known for my all out Water-type offensive. This is only a practice but I won't hold back and we'll still play by the banned trainer cards rules.
says.repeat: I haven't got time to go swimming today so do you want another match?
says.first_win: You really are strong and skilled!
says.rematch_win: Glad to see you're really learning a thing or two!
says.loss: Yaaaay! That feels great!

says.meet: I had a vision of your arrival! My name is Sabrina. I have had psychic powers since I was a child. You're here to play against me. I will grant you a match.
says.repeat: I knew you would return and this too shall not be the last time we meet.
says.first_win: This loss shocks me! But a loss is a loss. I admit I didn't work hard enough to win.
says.rematch_win: Your power... It far exceeds what I foresaw... Maybe it isn't possible to fully predict what the future holds...
says.loss: This turned out exactly as I had predicted.

says.meet: There's a lot of poisonous Pokemon out here in the trees so you have to be careful when you're wandering off the paths.
says.repeat: Hope you've not been stung!
says.first_win: You can clearly handle yourself so you should be fine.
says.rematch_win: Don't let your guard down!
says.loss: You might need to report to first aid...

says.meet: There's a lot of history in this forest, it's been around for thousands of years.
says.repeat: You haven't found any mysterious artifacts around here have you?
says.first_win: We can learn a lot of things from the past.
says.rematch_win: Even losses are a great way to learn.
says.loss: You're a thing of the past!

says.meet: You need a lot of luck in life, some things are entirely up to chance.

says.rematch_win: If I flip a coin 10,000 times, there's still a chance I never get heads.

says.meet: Good day. I'm not the most youthful but I love a good match.
says.repeat: Hello again, up for another match ey?
says.first_win: Hoh, hoh, very well played there.
